{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-de-d","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"54c8d72b3867133bbca74f39c4b06f1aeecff5f0c58ac9270f39109154e04b5c","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-de-class-d:lineage:32","source_registry_sha256":"7b6c7aeec232df29a8679bf39181604be2d91ce9a1cb4fcc709fed49cbe724bb","source_liveness_sha256":"53bd779b9965bd9d51630c8d8d055ccdc52a4d8ec7117a3b87241fc5129eb44f"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C","chunk_id":"C.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration","heading":"C — Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## C — Vehicle equipment, insurance, titles and registration

FACT_ID: sec07-F01 | anchor: A01
Vehicles used on Delaware highways must be registered. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F02 | anchor: A01
New Delaware residents have 60 days after moving to title and register their vehicles. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F03 | anchor: A01
A Delaware-registered automobile needs at least two white multibeam headlights, with one on either front side. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F04 | anchor: A01
High beams must illuminate people and vehicles at a distance of at least 350 feet. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F05 | anchor: A01
Low beams must illuminate people at least 100 feet ahead without shining into an approaching driver’s eyes. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F06 | anchor: A01
Headlights must operate while the wipers are used because of bad weather. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F07 | anchor: A01
The rear must have at least two red taillights of the original design, visible at 500 feet. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F08 | anchor: A01
At least one front parking light must be white or amber and visible at 500 feet. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F09 | anchor: A01
At least one rear parking light must be red and visible at 500 feet; a taillight can serve this purpose. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F10 | anchor: A01
The registration-plate light must be white and make the number readable at 50 feet. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F11 | anchor: A01
The plate light must not cast light toward vehicles proceeding in the same direction. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F12 | anchor: A01
A rear stop light of the original design must be amber, red, or a shade between them. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F13 | anchor: A01
A stop light must illuminate with brake-pedal use and remain visible at least 100 feet away in normal sunlight. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F14 | anchor: A01
When a vehicle has two stop lights, both must operate. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F15 | anchor: A01
Vehicles made after 1953 need two front and two rear turn signals. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F16 | anchor: A01
Front turn-signal colors may range from white through amber. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F17 | anchor: A01
Rear turn-signal colors may range from amber through red. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F18 | anchor: A01
Both turn-signal sets must be visible at 100 feet or more in normal sunlight. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F19 | anchor: A01
Turn signals fitted to vehicles made in 1953 or earlier must function. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F20 | anchor: A01
Passenger vehicles made after 1953 need two red rear reflectors. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F21 | anchor: A01
Vehicles made after 1977 need at least six reflectors: amber at each front side, red at each rear side, and two red at the rear. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F22 | anchor: A01
Reflectors require four square inches of reflecting area and visibility at 500 feet. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F23 | anchor: A01
Reflectors can be built into lamp lenses. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> pdf-0060]

FACT_ID: sec07-F24 | anchor: A02
Passenger vehicles made since 1972 need side markers: two amber toward the front sides and two red toward the rear sides. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F25 | anchor: A02
Side-marker lamps require four square inches of luminous lens area and visibility at 500 feet. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F26 | anchor: A02
Vehicle brakes must act evenly on every side and satisfy federal braking standards. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F27 | anchor: A02
The parking or emergency brake must halt the vehicle from 20 mph within 54 feet. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F28 | anchor: A02
The windshield and all side and rear windows must use automotive safety glass. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F29 | anchor: A02
Window stickers and signs are limited to legally required certificates or DMV-approved items. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F30 | anchor: A02
Windshield wipers must clear rain, snow and other moisture. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F31 | anchor: A02
A rear-view mirror must let the driver see vehicles moving in the same direction. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F32 | anchor: A02
If the interior mirror’s rearward view is obstructed, outside mirrors are required on both sides. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F33 | anchor: A02
Every vehicle needs a functioning muffler kept in continuous operation. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F34 | anchor: A02
Vehicle noise must meet federal standards, and excessive or loud noise is prohibited. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F35 | anchor: A02
The horn must be audible at least 200 feet away under normal conditions. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F36 | anchor: A02
Passenger cars made after January 1, 1968 need belts for every front-seat occupant. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F37 | anchor: A02
Trucks, buses and multipassenger vehicles made after July 1, 1971 need belts for every front-seat occupant. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F38 | anchor: A02
A vehicle may carry two spotlights, but their intense beams must not aim left or farther than 100 feet ahead. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F39 | anchor: A02
A vehicle may carry two white or yellow front fog lamps mounted 12 to 30 inches above ground. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F40 | anchor: A02
A fog-lamp beam must fall at least four inches over its first 25 feet. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F41 | anchor: A02
Rear backing lamps may use shades ranging from white to amber. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F42 | anchor: A02
Colored lighting beyond factory equipment, marker lamps and turn signals is reserved for emergency vehicles. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F43 | anchor: A02
No more than four front lamps rated at least 300 candlepower may be illuminated simultaneously. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F44 | anchor: A02
The center of a headlamp must sit between 24 and 54 inches above ground. [A02]
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0061]

FACT_ID: sec07-F45 | anchor: A03
A red light visible from the front is prohibited on an ordinary motor vehicle; emergency vehicles are excepted. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F46 | anchor: A03
Emergency vehicles, school buses and snow-removal equipment are among the exceptions to the general flashing-light prohibition. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F47 | anchor: A03
Snow-removal equipment may use green revolving or flashing lights. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F48 | anchor: A03
Turn signals and four-way hazard flashers are permitted flashing-light uses. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F49 | anchor: A03
Unauthorized additions such as frames, symbols or accessories on a license plate are forbidden. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F50 | anchor: A03
A lamp or reflector must not be installed if it tends to alter the vehicle’s original design or performance. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F51 | anchor: A03
Studded tires are allowed in Delaware from October 15 through April 15, including both endpoints. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F52 | anchor: A03
Studded tires are prohibited in Delaware from April 16 through October 14; drivers must follow other states’ rules while traveling there. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F53 | anchor: A03
Using a muffler cut-out is forbidden. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F54 | anchor: A03
Ordinary vehicles may not carry a siren or an exhaust or compression whistle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F55 | anchor: A03
A motor vehicle generally may tow only one vehicle; a tractor with a semitrailer may tow one additional vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F56 | anchor: A03
The connection between towing and towed vehicles must measure no more than 15 feet. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F57 | anchor: A03
A chain, cable or rope used for towing needs an attached red flag at least 12 inches square. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F58 | anchor: A03
The windshield tint restriction covers the area below the upper five inches, with the source also referring to an AS-1 boundary. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F59 | anchor: A03
Tint material must not cover vehicle lights or the license plate. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F60 | anchor: A03
A vehicle fitted with tint needs exterior mirrors on its left and right sides. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F61 | anchor: A03
Aftermarket tint immediately beside the driver requires a valid approved waiver kept in the vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F62 | anchor: A03
Headlights must be used during driving between sunset and sunrise. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F63 | anchor: A03
Headlights are required whenever visibility does not extend beyond 1,000 feet. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F64 | anchor: A03
The headlight-use subsection requires headlights whenever the windshield wipers are used. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F65 | anchor: A03
Use low beams beginning 500 feet before meeting another vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F66 | anchor: A03
Use low beams when following within 200 feet of another vehicle. [A03]
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0062]

FACT_ID: sec07-F67 | anchor: A04
Every vehicle occupant must be secured correctly by a belt or child safety seat. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-F68 | anchor: A04
An officer may stop a vehicle upon seeing an occupant without a belt. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]

FACT_ID: sec07-F69 | anchor: A04
The driver is ticketed for occupants who are unrestrained or restrained incorrectly. [A04]
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0063]
